+"""Generate and validate the fixed-scene align_blocks trajectory."""
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_robowits import Session
+
+
+ROOT = Path("/app/output")
+INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
+TRAJECTORY = ROOT / "trajectory.npz"
+
+
+def cube_xy(objects, name):
+    return np.asarray(objects[name]["position"][:2], dtype=float)
+
+
+def main():
+    s = Session("align_blocks", instance=INSTANCE)
+    p = s.primitives()
+    objs = s.objects()
+
+    # Keep the first and third cubes fixed. Place the second on the line
+    # through them, extended to y=0.30 so it remains well separated.
+    a = cube_xy(objs, "first target cube")
+    c = cube_xy(objs, "third target cube")
+    target_y = 0.30
+    target_x = a[0] + (target_y - a[1]) * (a[0] - c[0]) / (a[1] - c[1])
+    target_xy = np.array([target_x, target_y])
+    start = np.asarray(objs["second target cube"]["position"], dtype=float)
+    z_center = float(start[2])
+    quat = p["top_down_quat"](0.0)
+
+    print("initial objects:", json.dumps(objs), flush=True)
+    print("target xy:", target_xy.tolist(), "IK target:", flush=True)
+    print("target IK:", s.ik("left", [*target_xy, z_center], quat)[1:], flush=True)
+
+    s.record_start()
+
+    # Approach over the cube with the fingers open, descend to its center,
+    # close around the sides, and lift clear of neighboring objects.
+    p["open_gripper"]("left", steps=20)
+    p["move_ee"]("left", [start[0], start[1], z_center + 0.13], quat,
+                 linear=4, settle=5)
+    p["move_ee"]("left", [start[0], start[1], z_center], quat,
+                 linear=4, settle=8)
+    p["close_gripper"]("left", steps=30)
+    print("after grasp:", json.dumps(s.objects()["second target cube"]), flush=True)
+
+    p["move_ee"]("left", [start[0], start[1], z_center + 0.15], quat,
+                 linear=4, settle=5)
+    p["move_ee"]("left", [target_xy[0], target_xy[1], z_center + 0.15], quat,
+                 linear=8, settle=5)
+    p["move_ee"]("left", [target_xy[0], target_xy[1], z_center], quat,
+                 linear=4, settle=10)
+    p["open_gripper"]("left", steps=25)
+    p["move_ee"]("left", [target_xy[0], target_xy[1], z_center + 0.14], quat,
+                 linear=4, settle=10)
+    p["hold"](120)
+
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    status = s.status()
+    print("candidate status:", status, flush=True)
+    print("candidate objects:", json.dumps(s.objects()), flush=True)
+    if status["success"]:
+        s.save_trajectory(actions, TRAJECTORY,
+                          meta={"source": "gen.py", "moved": "second target cube",
+                                "target_xy": target_xy.tolist(), "n_actions": int(len(actions))})
+        print("saved:", TRAJECTORY, "actions:", len(actions), flush=True)
+
+        # The verifier replays from the frozen state; check the same exact
+        # action list twice before exiting.
+        results = [s.replay(actions) for _ in range(2)]
+        print("replay results:", json.dumps(results), flush=True)
+        if not all(r["success"] for r in results):
+            raise RuntimeError("candidate passed once but did not pass both reset/replays")
+    else:
+        print("not saved: trajectory has not passed the success predicate", flush=True)
+
+    s.close()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
